nodes.description: address internal _owner, the privileged owner account of Ownable
address private _managerAddress, privileged manager account of Managerable
IFNXOracle internal _oracle, external price oracle used by ImportOracle
uint32[] internal underlyingAssets, whitelist of eligible underlyings
IVolatility internal _volatility, external volatility module
IOptionsPrice internal _optionsPrice, external option pricing module
address[] private _operatorList, whitelist of operator accounts
uint256 private maxAmount = 1e30, upper bound of accepted input amounts
uint256 private minAmount = 1e2, lower bound of accepted input amounts
uint256 internal limitation = 1 hours, burn time limitation
OptionsInfo[] internal allOptions, global option database
mapping(address=>uint64[]) internal optionsBalances, per-user option ids
uint32[] internal expirationList, whitelist of allowed expirations
uint256 internal netWorthirstOption, first option position for net worth calc
mapping(address=>int256) internal optionsLatestNetWorth, latest net worth per settlement coin
uint256 internal occupiedFirstOption, first option position for collateral calc
uint256 internal callOccupied, total call options collateral occupied
uint256 internal putOccupied, total put options collateral occupied
int256 internal callLatestOccupied, last recorded call occupied value
int256 internal putLatestOccupied, last recorded put occupied value
address public implementation, delegatecall target of baseProxy
Ownable constructor, sets deployer as _owner
owner() view, returns _owner
isOwner() view, compares msg.sender with _owner
renounceOwnership(), onlyOwner, sets _owner to address(0)
transferOwnership(address), onlyOwner, forwards to _transferOwnership
_transferOwnership(address) internal, validates and writes _owner
onlyOwner modifier, requires isOwner()
onlyManager modifier, requires _managerAddress == msg.sender
setManager(address), onlyOwner, writes _managerAddress
getManager() view, returns _managerAddress
oraclegetPrices(uint256[]) internal, queries _oracle.getPrices and range checks
oraclePrice(address) internal, queries _oracle.getPrice with range check
oracleUnderlyingPrice(uint256) internal, queries _oracle.getUnderlyingPrice
oracleAssetAndUnderlyingPrice(address,uint256) internal, queries oracle for both prices
getOracleAddress() view, returns address(_oracle)
setOracleAddress(address), onlyOwner, replaces _oracle
addUnderlyingAsset(uint32), onlyOwner, adds underlying to whitelist
setUnderlyingAsset(uint32[]), onlyOwner, overwrites the underlying whitelist
removeUnderlyingAssets(uint32), onlyOwner, removes underlying from whitelist
getUnderlyingAssets() view, returns the underlying whitelist
isEligibleUnderlyingAsset(uint32) view, whitelist membership test
_getEligibleUnderlyingIndex(uint32) internal view, index lookup
getVolatilityAddress() view, returns address(_volatility)
setVolatilityAddress(address), onlyOwner, replaces _volatility
getOptionsPriceAddress() view, returns address(_optionsPrice)
setOptionsPriceAddress(address), onlyOwner, replaces _optionsPrice
onlyOperator modifier, requires _operatorList membership of msg.sender
onlyOperatorIndex(uint256) modifier, bounds check plus membership check at index
addOperator(address), onlyOwner, pushes into _operatorList
setOperator(uint256,address), onlyOwner, unchecked indexed write into _operatorList
removeOperator(address), onlyOwner, removes from _operatorList
getOperator() view, returns the whole operator list
setOperators(address[]), onlyOwner, replaces the operator list
isInputAmountInRange(uint256) view, compares against minAmount/maxAmount
getInputAmountRange() view, returns (minAmount,maxAmount)
setInputAmountRange(uint256,uint256), onlyOwner, sets amount bounds
InRange(uint256) modifier, requires amount inside [minAmount,maxAmount]
Smaller(uint256) modifier, requires amount <= maxAmount
Larger(uint256) modifier, requires amount >= minAmount
baseProxy constructor, stores implementation and delegatecalls initialize()
getImplementation() view, returns implementation address
setImplementation(address), onlyOwner, updates implementation and delegatecalls update()
delegateToImplementation(bytes) public, unrestricted delegatecall of caller data
delegateToViewImplementation(bytes) public view, self staticcall round-trip
delegateToViewAndReturn() internal view, staticcall self with raw msg.data
delegateAndReturn() internal, delegatecalls implementation with raw msg.data
OptionsProxy constructor, wires oracle, options price and volatility modules
proxy entry point setTimeLimitation(uint256) public, forwards calldata via delegatecall
proxy entry point createOptions(address,address,uint256,uint128,uint128,uint128,uint128) public
proxy entry point burnOptions(address,uint256,uint256,uint256) public
proxy entry point setOccupiedCollateral() public
proxy entry point setCollateralPhase(uint256,uint256,uint256,int256,int256) public
proxy entry point setSharedState(uint256,int256[],address[]) public
msg.sender as owner identity in Ownable (constructor, isOwner)
msg.sender as manager identity in Managerable.onlyManager
msg.sender as operator identity in Operator modifiers
constructor delegatecall to initialize() on the just-stored implementation
delegatecall to update() on the new implementation, executes in proxy storage
arbitrary delegatecall with caller-supplied bytes data, no access control
delegatecall of the full msg.data to the implementation contract
staticcall to address(this) re-entering the proxy with raw msg.data
inline assembly returndatacopy and raw revert/return of unvalidated returndata
unbounded array index write into _operatorList in setOperator

setVolatilityAddress stores the address into _volatility
setOptionsPriceAddress stores the address into _optionsPrice
onlyOperator checks msg.sender membership in _operatorList
onlyOperatorIndex compares msg.sender against _operatorList[index]

caller-supplied index is used directly as an array index
operator address is written at an unvalidated index of _operatorList
setOperators replaces the whole operator list
removeOperator removes an address from _operatorList
setUnderlyingAsset overwrites the underlyingAssets whitelist
addUnderlyingAsset appends an underlying to the whitelist
removeUnderlyingAssets deletes an entry from underlyingAssets
asset id array is passed into oraclegetPrices
prices array returned by the oracle is range-checked in the loop

oraclePrice queries the external oracle contract
cToken id is passed to oracleUnderlyingPrice
oracleUnderlyingPrice queries the external oracle contract

second returned price is range-checked in oracleAssetAndUnderlyingPrice
oracleAssetAndUnderlyingPrice queries the external oracle contract
Amount parameter is compared against minAmount and maxAmount

setInputAmountRange writes the new minAmount
setInputAmountRange writes the new maxAmount

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is only used to call _transferOwnership, so it collapses into the transferOwnership core function
managerAddress is written straight into _managerAddress inside setManager
underlyings is assigned to underlyingAssets only inside setUnderlyingAsset
removeUnderlying only feeds the removal helper inside removeUnderlyingAssets
underlying is only appended to the whitelist inside addUnderlyingAsset
addAddress is only pushed into _operatorList inside addOperator
index is used directly as an array index for _operatorList in the setOperator write
removeAddress is only used for the operator removal lookup
operators replaces _operatorList wholesale inside setOperators
oracle is cast and stored into _oracle inside setOracleAddress
volatility is cast and stored into _volatility inside setVolatilityAddress
optionsPrice is cast and stored into _optionsPrice inside setOptionsPriceAddress
_minAmount is assigned to minAmount inside setInputAmountRange
_maxAmount is assigned to maxAmount inside setInputAmountRange
Amount is only compared with the range bounds inside isInputAmountInRange
amount is validated against minAmount/maxAmount by the InRange modifier
implementation_ is stored and delegatecalled only by the baseProxy constructor
implementation_ is stored and delegatecalled only by setImplementation
data is the raw calldata handed to the unrestricted delegatecall
success is the boolean flag returned by the delegatecall and used for revert handling
returnData is the raw returndata produced by the delegatecall and returned to the caller
assets is only passed to the oracle and used as the validation loop bound
prices holds the oracle result that oraclegetPrices range-checks
len is derived from assets.length to bound the price validation loop
i is only the loop counter of the price validation loop
asset is only used as the oracle lookup key inside oraclePrice
price holds the single oracle value that oraclePrice range-checks and returns
cToken is only used as the oracle lookup key inside oracleUnderlyingPrice
price1 is the first oracle output that is range-checked and returned
price2 is the second oracle output that is range-checked and returned
from is only forwarded as part of the createOptions calldata to the implementation
id is only forwarded as part of the burnOptions calldata to the implementation
totalCallOccupied is only forwarded to the implementation through the proxy entry point
newFirstOption is only forwarded to the implementation through the proxy entry point
